remarks:
Welcome to 4772 Cottage Rd, a beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath ranch offering high-end finishes, thoughtful updates, and an impressive amount of garage/workshop space. Set on approximately 1 acre, this property backs to a cornfield, providing peaceful farm views, added privacy, and a low-maintenance setting.

The entire home has been renovated with quality and style in mind. The kitchen and both bathrooms feature fully tiled finishes with an upscale, modern look. Both bathrooms offer no-step showers, while one also features a no-step jetted tub. Original hardwood floors are in excellent condition and add warmth and character throughout the home. First-floor laundry is conveniently located in the primary bedroom ensuite.

The finished living space is complemented by a full basement offering excellent bonus space for storage, recreation, hobbies, or a workshop. A large rear deck overlooks the property and provides a great place to enjoy the peaceful setting. Walking the yard you will find apple, peach, and pear trees as well as grape vines to add to this serine back yard escape.

For those needing serious storage, workspace, or room for vehicles and equipment, this property is hard to beat. A newly constructed approximately 30' x 40' pole barn features concrete floors, electric, two overhead doors, and a covered patio area. Combined with the additional detached garage, the property offers 5+ car capacity with abundant workshop and storage space.

Major updates include updated plumbing and electrical throughout the home, a whole-house water filtration system, radon mitigation system, Generac whole-house generator, furnace, and hot water tank, with these major mechanical updates completed between 2019–2022. Aluminum siding on the home provides easy maintenance, while the detached garage features wood siding. Appliances are negotiable.

A rare combination of a fully renovated home, high-end finishes, acreage, privacy, and exceptional garage/workshop space in a peaceful Royalton setting.
